criteria.description: The proposed approach can achieve the goal within the stated constraints and available capabilities.
The task boundaries and repository-relative file ownership are explicit, minimal, and within the requested scope.
Dependencies, sequencing, and shared-file ordering are explicit and executable.
Acceptance criteria are observable and each task has sufficient verification evidence.
Risks, approvals, rollback implications, and YAGNI limits are addressed.
The implementation matches the requested specification and every acceptance criterion.
Normal behavior, validation, failure handling, and error paths are correct.
State transitions, security boundaries, and data integrity are preserved.
The change is understandable, bounded, and free of unrelated or speculative work.
Existing interfaces remain compatible and relevant tests or checks cover the change.
Review evidence is current, complete, and bound to the reviewed workspace.
Combined task behavior satisfies the intended end-to-end outcome.
Shared contracts, schemas, and interfaces remain compatible across the integrated changes.
Task interactions, assumptions, and shared-file conflicts are resolved or explicitly bounded.
Recovery, rollback, and partial-failure behavior remain safe and executable.
Remaining delivery risks, approvals, and release constraints are understood and acceptable.
